report.headline: VISTA-16 phase 3 trial of varespladib stopped early for futility; human genetics show PLA2G2A has no causal role in coronary disease (association score 0.0), making target_not_causal the primary failure mode.
report.summary: The VISTA-16 trial randomized 5,189–6,500 acute coronary syndrome patients to varespladib or placebo on top of atorvastatin 80 mg daily, with a primary morbidity/mortality endpoint at 16 weeks. The independent DSMB recommended stopping the study on 9 March 2012 due to lack of efficacy, and enrollment was closed with patients removed from therapy. Human genetic evidence gives PLA2G2A a coronary artery disorder association score of 0.0 with zero evidence items, indicating no causal link, and the intended biomarker sPLA2-IIA mass is classified as non-causal. The phase 2 FRANCIS-ACS trial had already shown varespladib reduced LDL-C and inflammatory biomarkers by ~84–87% but produced no difference in clinical cardiovascular events. Confidence in the target_not_causal conclusion is high.
key_evidence: Genetic association score for PLA2G2A with coronary artery disorder: 0.0 (opentargets:PLA2G2A)

mechanism.target_genetics_rationale: PLA2G2A genetic association score with coronary artery disorder is 0.0 with zero evidence items (f_2edf1b4368b6c8). Reference table indicates sPLA2-IIA mass is non-causal for coronary disease. No human genetic support for causality of this target.

mechanism.notes: VISTA-16 (NCT01130246) was a phase 3 trial of varespladib 500 mg daily in ~5189-6500 ACS patients on atorvastatin, stopped early by DSMB for lack of efficacy (f_afd97006fdfa09, f_d9b792c30287eb). Primary endpoint at 16 weeks (f_beebbdf4bb8ce6). Intended biomarker sPLA2-IIA mass has no placebo-adjusted change data; only within-arm reductions reported (up to -83.6% at 8 weeks, f_aa49aa85cb429e). LDL-C placebo-adjusted change derived from phase 2 FRANCIS-ACS trial (similar population, same dose/background therapy) shows minimal incremental LDL-C lowering (-6.2%) beyond high-intensity statin. No follow-up duration, event counts, BP changes, or outcome HR reported in available facts.

issues.issue: The changes array for sPLA2-IIA has null values with no fact citations. The method states no placebo-adjusted change exists, but should cite the verified facts that document within-arm sPLA2-IIA changes (f_02e0ba985c2f12, f_1cf8dcce9cbe8d, f_4e0bc22120a2e8, f_aa49aa85cb429e, f_cd83522416fba7, f_d72e1eeb53480f) to satisfy the automatic check and document why placebo-adjusted data is unavailable.
issues.request: Add fact_ids to the sPLA2-IIA changes entry citing the within-arm sPLA2-IIA biomarker changes that are not placebo-adjusted.

issues.issue: Two placebo-adjusted phase 2 biomarker changes (f_1bbee001adb0d2: -24%, f_5db4a46719eef0: -27%) are labeled 'other' biomarker. If 'other' refers to sPLA2-IIA mass or activity, a quantified placebo-adjusted change exists and must be used as calculator input per protocol. The biomarker identity must be resolved.
issues.request: Search PMC2653470 (pmid:19029066) to identify what biomarker 'other' represents in these two placebo-adjusted phase 2 changes. If it is sPLA2-IIA, update calculator input with the placebo-adjusted change at the dose closest to VISTA-16 (500 mg daily).

issues.issue: Calculator assumptions include 'effect shown at 5 years' but no verified fact supports this claim. The trial was stopped at 16 weeks primary endpoint.
issues.request: Remove or source the 'effect shown at 5 years' assumption; it appears unsupported in the verified facts.

issues.issue: followup_years is null but primary endpoint is at 16 weeks (f_beebbdf4bb8ce6). While the trial stopped early, 16 weeks (0.31 years) is a documented protocol timepoint that could be noted as planned follow-up.
issues.request: Consider setting followup_years to 0.31 with fact_id f_beebbdf4bb8ce6 and a caveat that the trial stopped early, or keep null with explicit note.

issues.issue: sPLA2-IIA changes entry cites contradicted and not_found facts: f_cd83522416fba7 is an IC50 (87 µM) not a biomarker change (verifier: contradicts); f_02e0ba985c2f12 (-100%), f_4e0bc22120a2e8 (-40 µM), f_d72e1eeb53480f (9 nM) not_found in sources. Only f_aa49aa85cb429e (-83.6%) and f_1cf8dcce9cbe8d (10 µM) are confirmed within-arm reductions. Since no placebo-adjusted sPLA2-IIA change exists, the entry should cite only confirmed within-arm facts or omit specific fact citations.
issues.request: Update sPLA2-IIA changes entry: remove contradicted/not_found fact citations; keep only confirmed within-arm facts (f_aa49aa85cb429e, f_1cf8dcce9cbe8d) or replace source with 'No placebo-adjusted change available; within-arm reductions confirmed at 500 mg daily (f_aa49aa85cb429e, f_1cf8dcce9cbe8d)'.

issues.issue: LDL-C pct_change=-6.2% flagged by automatic check as not matching cited facts. The value is correctly computed from within-arm changes (drug -49.6% f_765f7a27d1bf23 minus placebo -43.4% f_978b4a6ae2f3af = -6.2%), but the check expects a direct placebo-adjusted fact. Verify whether the source paper (pmid:20863951) reports a between-group difference; if so, use that instead of computed difference. If not, the computed value is acceptable per protocol (placebo-adjusted phase 2 at closest dose), but the method description should explicitly state 'computed from within-arm values' and the source should reference both fact IDs.
issues.request: Check pmid:20863951 for reported placebo-adjusted LDL-C difference. If reported, use that value and cite it. If not, keep computed -6.2% but update method to 'Computed from within-arm percent changes at 8 weeks on 500 mg daily + atorvastatin: drug -49.6% (f_765f7a27d1bf23) minus placebo -43.4% (f_978b4a6ae2f3af) = -6.2%' and ensure source cites both fact IDs.

issues.issue: Hypothesis 'insufficient_data' cites not_found/contradicted facts (f_02e0ba985c2f12, f_4e0bc22120a2e8, f_cd83522416fba7, f_d72e1eeb53480f) as evidence that 'all sPLA2-IIA changes are within-arm'. Should cite only confirmed within-arm facts (f_aa49aa85cb429e, f_1cf8dcce9cbe8d).
issues.request: Update insufficient_data hypothesis 'for' references: replace the list of sPLA2-IIA fact IDs with only confirmed within-arm facts (f_aa49aa85cb429e, f_1cf8dcce9cbe8d).

issues.issue: sPLA2-IIA changes entry has unit '%' but cited confirmed facts use mixed units (f_aa49aa85cb429e: %, f_1cf8dcce9cbe8d: µM). Since pct_change is null, this is cosmetic but should be consistent.
issues.request: Change unit to 'mixed' or remove unit field when pct_change is null, or add note that within-arm changes reported in both % and µM.
